name: io.github.mertcanvural/overlayrisk-witness
description: Run the free independent before/after accessibility-overlay witness (accessiBe / UserWay) on any public URL — returns one documented finding where the page's public ADA/WCAG claims don't hold up, with a timestamp.

environmentVariables.name: OVERLAYRISK_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the hosted witness endpoint (defaults to https://overlayrisk.com/api/witness).
